objective: H2 translation-efficiency (TE = ribosome-protected-fragment count / mRNA count, per gene). Assemble matched RNA-seq + Ribo-seq PAIRS (same samples) to enable H2 pretraining.
method: Prefer processed footprint/RNA count tables (RiboBase/RPFdb/GEO supplementary); do not download raw FASTQ. Per-gene TE computed as log2((RPF_CPM+0.5)/(mRNA_CPM+0.5)) per sample, filtering genes with mean mRNA count >=10.

summary.generic_human_paired_N_source: RiboBase (massiveNGSpipe / Cenik lab), human Ribo-seq samples matched with corresponding RNA-seq. Genome Biol 2024 PMC11326257. TE tables HELD on S3 (Zenodo 10373032).
summary.h2_pretraining_basis: Feasible NOW on GENERIC human data (RiboBase TE tables, 1282 matched human Ribo+RNA samples across 77 cell-line/tissue contexts, ~11k genes; held on S3). Immune-SPECIFIC fine-tuning/eval feasible on a smaller held anchor set (human Jurkat T-cell activation 9 samples + mouse CD8 memory-T + mouse BMDM-LPS ready-made TE), with more immune studies identified and fetch-ready.

caveats: training_eligible=false: these are inventory + TE tables, not yet ingested/QC'd into the training cache.

GENERIC-vs-IMMUNE transfer risk: the large held pool (RiboBase, 1282 human samples) is dominated by non-immune cell lines (HeLa/HEK293/K562/HepG2 etc.) at BASELINE. It teaches the sequence/codon->TE transform but not immune-stimulus response. Immune-specific held anchors total only ~23 paired samples across 3 studies.

BATCH/pipeline heterogeneity: RiboBase is uniformly reprocessed (good, low batch); the individual immune GEO studies were computed with different aligners/normalizations by their authors -> cross-study TE is not directly comparable without harmonized reprocessing. Held immune TE (GSE254157/254230, GSE168476) was recomputed by us with a single CPM-ratio method for internal consistency; GSE99787 is author-provided (different method).

SPECIES mix: most immune-stimulus paired studies are MOUSE (BMDM-LPS, CD8-T, CD4-T, DC). Human immune-stimulus paired ribo-seq is scarce (Jurkat T-cell activation GSE254157/254230 is the main held human immune anchor; GSE240674 human monocyte LPS-tolerance is fetch-ready).

TE definition: computed as normalized-RPF/normalized-mRNA per gene (log2 CPM ratio); RiboBase uses CLR normalization. Different studies use RPKM/TPM ratios. Absolute TE values are not cross-method comparable; within-study contrasts (stimulated vs resting) are the reliable signal.
No true NK-cell paired ribo+RNA study found. B-cell paired data essentially absent (GSE133934 is ribo-only, n=2).
RPFdb/RDP hosts (rpfdb.org, rdp.ucc.ie) timed out from this sandbox; their large matched pools (2343 / ~thousands) are IDENTIFIED and fetch-ready from a networked host but NOT held.
